subject.title: feat: add publisher following and activity timeline

question: Should ClawHub now own a durable public publisher follow graph and pull-based release activity timeline as a supported social discovery surface?
rationale: The patch deliberately creates persisted relationship data, public graph endpoints, and profile/discovery UX; tests can validate mechanics but cannot decide the intended privacy, retention, abuse, and product-support boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the social discovery surface
options.body: Approve the public follow-graph and pull-timeline boundary, then require a restacked branch and real runtime proof before normal merge review.

options.title: Keep follows private or API-only
options.body: Ask for a reduced implementation that avoids public follower/following discovery until the product contract is separately approved.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause this optional social lane and revisit after a maintainer defines ownership, abuse handling, and retention expectations.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the social discovery surface
recommendation.body: Approve the public follow-graph and pull-timeline boundary, then require a restacked branch and real runtime proof before normal merge review.

likelyOwner.reason: He has already reviewed the most consequential publication-visibility and scheduling behavior in this feature path.
